pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->

This adds tests for `SecurityPorfolioManager.GetMarginRemaning` and fixes the case of trading equities in the opposite direction as the position held.

Also, some unit tests are added for `PositionGroupBuyingPowerModel.GetPositionGroupBuyingPower` to reproduce the cases when trading options -- either single or in strategies -- when they are already being held -- again, either in single positions or different strategies different than the one being traded. This method -- and possibly the engine (see #7309) -- still needs fixing to be able to close #7255

issue_context.title: Consider every impacted position for position group available buying power calculation
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->

`PositionGroupBuyingPowerModel.GetPositionGroupBuyingPower` takes into account margin used by every position in the contemplated group to adjust available buying power, including existing groups that are different (like from different strategies) than the contemplated one but include any of its positions.

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->

`PositionGroupBuyingPowerModel.GetPositionGroupBuyingPower` only takes into account groups that are exactly the same (same key) as the contemplated one, like when closing/reducing the same strategy (or its inverted version).

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->

Take a look at [`PositionGroupBuyingPowerModel.GetReservedBuyingPowerImpact`](https://github.com/jhonabreul/Lean/blob/7f15202dfc082fe56ca6f92008c918c5f2887bc0/Common/Securities/Positions/PositionGroupBuyingPowerModel.cs#LL75C29-L75C29), it gets the buying power delta you would have after the given orders are filled, considering every group that would get impacted.

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->

Place orders for two different strategies, with each containing at least one option leg which symbol is also in the other one. Or place an order for a strategy and then another one for one of its options.

Then try reducing the position for one of the strategies. Only this strategy will get picked to adjust the available buying power, without considering the other group which also contain one of its options.

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->

Windows 11
